en: A hand‑colored vintage postcard depicting the entrance road and gate to a hilltop castle complex. The scene shows a stone path leading uphill along a wooden fence toward an arched gateway in a fortification wall. Above and behind the gate stand medieval buildings with steep slate roofs and a tall square tower with a pointed spire. Trees surround the walls. The image has soft pastel sky colors typical of early colorized postcards. German text is printed in red beneath the image.
